caption: The drawing in grayscale depicts a decorative goblet with a lid. The goblet is octagonal and has two horizontal bands of twisted rope-like design, one around the widest part of the cup and one near the top edge. The lid is domed and features a sculpted lion in a reclining position with one paw raised and mouth open, placed atop a branch-like element. The goblet's stem is short and robust, flaring out at the base to a wide, circular foot edged with a scalloped texture. The stem has three sculpted faces at its upper part, each projecting outward, and the stem itself has a vertical, textured appearance resembling wood or bark. The entire composition is rendered with shaded pencil work on a beige background, emphasizing the transparency and reflective quality of the goblet.
title: Compote
